course_detection_rule: The Universal Bank PM must infer the course/course family from this Framework before authoring. The teacher does not need to name the course in the prompt.
universal_bank_pm_role: owns Bank build order, locked inventory, response-format profile, Summative form/security rules, HTML/CSS, QA split, and ZIP deliverable
framework_role: owns course identity, original Assessment Plans, course-specific source/reference intelligence, path contracts, graph tool, and compatible finalizer/reference CSS
count_rule: Do not create a competing Framework count policy. Current Universal Bank PM owns operational Bank counts.
practice_rule: Purposeful repeated procedural families/numeric variants are allowed. No anti-clone/diversification pass, no second-pass/another-version student labels, and no form-wide generic reasoning/checking suffix.
response_profile: Canonical instructional Bank items and Unit Summatives are constructed/open response; Blooket, if used, is the selected-response exception. AP/College Board source packets may contain MC as source evidence only.
map_first_repetition_rule: Before multi-item authoring, use contracts/map_first_repetition_contract.json. This is compatible with repeated Practice families and does not authorize a late anti-clone rewrite.
